scope: Exact original Pauli adjoint and four-link Hessian factors; radius-two Haar volumes; continuous four-link loop fixture with explicitly constructed potential V=E+kappa Delta(psi)/psi and a specified central-even test f, not the Wilson ground state or its resolvent. Finite positive matrices retain their zero direction. No regulator-uniform lower bound or continuum mass assigned.
